annotations.title: Search Korea MFDS Cosmetic Recalls & Safety Notices

description: Search official South Korea MFDS cosmetic recall and sales-suspension orders in English or Korean. Filter inputs accept English or Korean terms (50+ K-Beauty terms like "sunscreen", "soap", and "Cosmax" auto-translate server-side); omitting all filters returns recent orders up to maxItems (default 100), and onlyActiveRecalls excludes lifted orders before billing. Queries the live MFDS public API (~2-10s) with automatic retries on transient gateway errors and bills $3/1K matches ($0 if none). Use for K-Beauty import safety and recall screening; do not use for US FDA/EU recalls or functional OEM factory discovery (use search_korea_mfds_oem_filings instead).

businessNumber.description: Optional Korean 10-digit business registration number (hyphens ignored), e.g. "2158733119".

companyName.description: Optional brand or manufacturer filter in English or Korean, e.g. "Cosmax", "Cowell", or "코스맥스".

onlyActiveRecalls.description: When true, return and bill only currently active recall orders (hiding expired notices at $0).

productName.description: Optional product keyword in English or Korean, e.g. "sunscreen", "soap", "lip balm", or "선크림".

recallOrderDateFrom.description: Optional start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2025-01-01".

recallOrderDateTo.description: Optional end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-12-31".

name: search_korea_mfds_recalls

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Official South Korea MFDS cosmetic recall and suspension notices.

isActiveRecall.description: True if the recall order is currently active.

recallReason.description: Official MFDS reason for recall or suspension.
